Visual Direction ReviewPass 02  ·  2026
Your iPhone Is A Cinema Camera  ·  Field Guide 001
Three
Directions
Each direction is a cover plus the Shoot With Intention interior, the page that shows what happens to a layout once six real frames land in it. Same palette and typefaces throughout. What changes is how they are used.
A
Cobalt Field Guide
Cobalt is the publication. The title runs at 114px in white and the photograph is set into the colour as an inset plate. Interior bands: cobalt header, white body, black technical footer.
Sheets 2 – 3
Cover · Interior
B
Cinematic Photography
The image is the cover, full bleed. Cobalt arrives as an asymmetric panel the photograph runs past. The interior grid descends one frame, then two, then three, as the coverage tightens.
Sheets 4 – 5
Cover · Interior
C
Technical Field Manual
The spine widens into a cobalt data rail carrying the running technical record, and on the interior the coverage index. Frames sit in a uniform contact sheet.
Sheets 6 – 7
Cover · Interior

Your iPhone Is A Cinema CameraField Guide 001
07  /  Coverage
Shoot With Intention
The creators whose work looks finished are thinking in shots, not clips.
Wide→ Medium→ Close→ Detail→ Movement→ Reveal One subject · six ways
M07.1
Video FrameWide16:9 · 213 × 158
01Wide
Where are we. Opens the piece and gives everything after it a place to happen.
M07.2
Video FrameMedium16:9 · 213 × 158
02Medium
Your default. Most of what you say to camera lives here. Conversational, not formal.
M07.3
Video FrameClose16:9 · 213 × 158
03Close
Save it for the line that matters. It reads as emphasis, so spend it deliberately.
M07.4
Video FrameDetail16:9 · 213 × 158
04Detail
Hands, product, texture. The shot that covers a cut and proves you were there.
M07.5
Video FrameMovement16:9 · 213 × 158
05Movement
Slow push, slow pan, or walk with the subject. Start moving before you record.
M07.6
Video FrameReveal16:9 · 213 × 158
06Reveal
Start hidden, end on the thing. Behind a door, past a shoulder, up from a table.
Shoot All Six
Of the same subject, in the same light, before you move on.
Hold Longer
Around ten seconds a shot. Short clips are what leave an edit feeling rushed.
Move The Camera
Six frames from one tripod height is still one angle.
M07.7 · QR · Reel
How I film myself, all six angles, one setup
Shot for shot through a real piece, with the frame and the reason for each one on screen.
